open_points.subject: ProofResult identity
open_points.text: “Substitution: proving the same version gives the same result.” / “whether a flow version whose proof failed because a binding was not yet accepted can be proven again later — closed by A05 (yes).”
open_points.question: When mutable binding status changes a proof result for the same flow version, what facts identify that ProofResult?
options: The result is a snapshot identified by the flow version plus the binding states used
Each proof computation is a distinct observation
The first result is authoritative and cannot change
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as a snapshot value whose identity includes the binding states used.

open_points.subject: AdmissionVerdict identity
open_points.text: “Substitution: a verdict for the same implementation and corpus is the same verdict.” / “every active case of the corpus is run again for the implementation at admission time, and the verdict covers exactly those executions.”
open_points.question: When the same implementation is submitted again against the unchanged corpus, is the new admission a distinct verdict with new TrialExecutions, or is the existing verdict reused?
options: Create a distinct admission verdict for each admission run
Reuse the existing verdict and do not rerun trials
Rerun trials but replace or amend the existing verdict
open_points.default_guess: Create a distinct admission verdict for each admission run so its newly created TrialExecutions remain attributable.

open_points.subject: Explicit try action
open_points.text: “try an implementation | agent | trial evidence per case”
open_points.question: Which trial cases does one explicit try action execute?
options: One case named by the request
A set of cases named by the request
Every case in the contract version's current corpus
open_points.default_guess: Execute every case in the current corpus and create one TrialExecution per case.

open_points.subject: Activation after trial-corpus growth
open_points.text: “Read by activation, which requires an `admitted` verdict over the current corpus.” / “The current activation of a contract version is the one recorded last.”
open_points.question: When a trial case is added or captured after an implementation was activated, does that implementation remain current and runnable without a verdict over the enlarged corpus?
options: It remains active and runnable; the current-corpus requirement is checked only when creating an activation
Its activation remains recorded but is unusable until the implementation is admitted over the enlarged corpus
The kernel automatically readmits the active implementation when the corpus grows
open_points.default_guess: Keep the existing activation runnable and require the enlarged corpus only for a later submission or rollback.

open_points.subject: TrialExecution file-output disclosure class
open_points.text: “for a `file` port only its facts — digest, size and media type” / “a trial case's expected output the highest class among that case's inputs, as a trial execution's output does”
open_points.question: Does a file output recorded by TrialExecution carry a disclosure class, and if so is it stored in the evidence or only derived from the trial inputs?
options: Store the derived disclosure class with the file-output facts
Treat the class as a derived model fact and recompute it from the trial inputs
File-output evidence has no disclosure class
open_points.default_guess: Store the disclosure class derived from the trial inputs with the file-output facts.

open_points.subject: Installation identity and token reload
open_points.text: “Identity: value” / “the configuration is read at start; the token list is read again whenever it has changed”
open_points.question: When agent tokens are added, changed or removed without restarting, is this the same Installation whose facts changed, a new Installation value snapshot, or a separately reloaded authorization configuration outside Installation identity?
options: Installation is a stable entity whose token configuration may change
Each token-list reload produces a new Installation value snapshot
Installation remains the startup value and agent tokens are separately reloaded facts outside its identity
open_points.default_guess: Treat the installation as a stable entity with a reloadable agent-token configuration.
